title: backlog.py close leaves relates_to links to the items it deletes
goal: backlog.py close removes the ids it deletes from every remaining item's relates_to (or refuses and names them), so backlog.py check passes right after a close; test_backlog.py's test_close_drops_relates_to plants an open item that relates to a closed one.
notes: Closing SP-liemltg2 and SP-aikswrrl each left dangling relates_to links that failed backlog.check until removed by hand.
